title: Gold price drops ₹2,700 to ₹1.55 lakh/10g; silver slips by ₹10,000
text: Gold price drops ₹2,700 to ₹1.55 lakh/10g; silver slips by ₹10,000. Traders say sharp correction in domestic bullion prices reflected selling pressure in the local market after the recent rally, with both precious metals pulling back
